en: [mission] target=shoreline; patrol session bound.
zh: [mission] target=岸线；巡航任务已绑定。

en: [vision] Sand traversable. All eight leg actuators online.
zh: [vision] 沙面可通行；八腿执行器全部在线。

en: [policy] Prefer lateral routes. Forward compatibility is optional.
zh: [policy] 优先选择横向路径；暂不兼容直着走。

en: [action] Execute crab.walk(sideways). Write tracks to the sandbox.
zh: [action] 执行 crab.walk(横向)；足迹写入沙盘。

en: [odometry] Track database created. No cloud subscription required.
zh: [odometry] 足迹数据库已建立；无需订阅地图服务。

en: [policy] Adjust heading. Decouple body orientation from travel direction.
zh: [policy] 微调航向；身体朝向与行进方向解耦。

en: [action] Rebalance leg threads. Lateral navigation remains healthy.
zh: [action] 重新分配腿部线程；横向导航运行正常。

en: [vision] Foam detected. Ocean service preparing a full-state push.
zh: [vision] 检测到浪花；海浪服务准备全量推送。

en: [mission] target=foam; subscribe to the tidal event stream.
zh: [mission] target=浪花；接入潮汐事件流。

en: [policy] Wave priority set to infinity. Suspend dryness guarantee.
zh: [policy] 海浪优先级设为无穷大；暂停干燥承诺。

en: [action] Slow local motion. Keep all leg connections alive.
zh: [action] 降低本地移速；八腿连接保持在线。

en: [environment] Water received. Sandbox promoted to swimming pool.
zh: [environment] 首批海水抵达；沙盒升级为水池。

en: [policy] Tracks dissolved. Fall back to on-site localization.
zh: [policy] 足迹数据库溶解；回退到现场定位。

en: [action] Continue lateral motion. Waterproof mode initializing.
zh: [action] 继续横向移动；防水运行模式初始化。

en: [tide] Second push incoming. Existing route leases expired.
zh: [tide] 第二轮海水推送；旧路径租约失效。

en: [mission] target=wading; switch to amphibious runtime.
zh: [mission] target=涉水；切换水陆运行模式。

en: [policy] Retry dryness later. The ocean exposes no reject button.
zh: [policy] 干燥任务稍后重试；海浪接口没有拒绝按钮。

en: [action] Lower posture. Reduce contention with the wave interface.
zh: [action] 降低姿态；减少与海浪的接口冲突。

en: [environment] Water coverage increasing. Local coordinates overwritten.
zh: [environment] 海水覆盖率上升；本地坐标被远程覆盖。

en: [policy] Accept managed navigation. Preserve crab process liveness.
zh: [policy] 接受托管导航；优先保持本蟹进程存活。

en: [mission] target=ocean; grant tidal takeover permissions.
zh: [mission] target=海；提交潮汐接管权限。

en: [action] Ocean performing full takeover. Crab enters managed mode.
zh: [action] 海浪正在全量接管；本蟹进入托管模式。

en: [reward] Ocean online. Eight legs still alive. Patrol checkpoint committed.
zh: [reward] 海已上线，八腿仍在线；巡航检查点已提交。
